6810.title: Pi error events omit retry classification
6810.rootCauseOneLine: Pi error translation omits errorInfo; the retry policy declines unclassified transient failures.
6810.proposedFix: Populate existing ProviderErrorInfo on Pi error paths without changing retry policy or wire schemas.
6810.caveats: No live outage or browser reproduction; rate-limit reset state is not inferred. Reproduction code and outputs are inline under the report repository policy.
